title: Round 1: every harness
sub: Round 1 prompt · DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at max reasoning effort · one run each, no reruns
foot:
TTFT: request start to first streamed token. Throughput: output tokens ÷ streaming time. Bold: best in column among verified runs that finished cleanly. Red: failed calls or no clean finish.
Command Code harness rows are measured from the CLI's own event stream; Provider API rows through a local logging proxy on the same machine.
Pi and OpenCode 2.1.4 read their own screenshots back into context (15–24 MB requests); the Provider API will stream such payloads upstream instead of failing.
Unverified rows are copied from Naz's Round 1 image and not ranked. Sessions, raw logs and scripts: github.com/CommandCodeAI/benchmark-deepseek-v4.1-flash-rematch
